name: Shackleton Crater region (South Pole)
note: IAU Gazetteer centre of Shackleton crater. The window of about 110 km holds its permanently shadowed floor, its rim and the ridge toward de Gerlache: a regional profile, not the rim alone. 'Peak near Shackleton' and 'Connecting Ridge' were among NASA's 13 Artemis III candidate regions of 2022; the list of nine of October 2024 no longer names them.

name: Malapert Massif (South Pole)
note: IAU Gazetteer centre of Mons Malapert (LOLA 2011 network). 'Malapert Massif' is one of NASA's nine Artemis III candidate regions (October 2024).

name: Mare Tranquillitatis pit
note: Pit coordinates from Robinson et al. (2012).

name: Jezero Crater
note: IAU Gazetteer centre; Perseverance landing region.

name: Gale Crater
note: IAU Gazetteer centre; Curiosity landing region.

name: Arcadia Planitia (ice-rich mid-latitudes)
note: Approximate centre of the ice-rich zone mapped by SHARAD (Bramson et al. 2015). Future site: studied for human landings (ice as a resource), no mission selected.

name: Oxia Planum (Rosalind Franklin landing site)
note: Future site of another agency: landing site of ESA's ExoMars Rosalind Franklin rover (launch planned in 2028), clay-bearing plains (Quantin-Nataf et al. 2021, Astrobiology 21(3); Fawdon et al. 2024, Journal of Maps). Coordinates 18.275 N, 335.368 E.
